newsitem.title: USA: Platinum Q1 international data omitted.
newsitem.headline: Platinum Q1 international data omitted.

text.p: Platinum Entertainment Inc said Tuesday it omitted international sales data in its August 31 first quarter because the data was unavailable from MCA International Ltd.
Platinum has an agreement with MCA to manufacture and distribute its records overseas.

"MCA has had problems in providing quarterly sales data to us within 45 days of the quarter's close. As a result, no international sales or earnings are reflected in this three month period," said president Steven Devick in a statement.

Earlier, Platinum reported quarterly revenues of $6.5 million and a loss of $631,000 or $0.12 per share. The company produces, licenses, acquires and markets recorded music for a variety of music formats.
